correctness.rationale: Complete finite enumeration proves the lower bounds and labeled extremal counts for \(n=7\) and \(n=8\). Orbit-size calculations then exhaustively prove the stated isomorphism classifications. A second implementation with a different containment test reproduces the extremal counts.

originality.rationale: Targeted current-literature, exact-phrase, equivalent-notation, and published-finding corpus searches found the sufficiently-large-\(n\) union-of-three-cliques theorem and unrelated saturation results, but no source giving the \(n=7\) or \(n=8\) exact values or classifications.

value.rationale: The result resolves the first two admissible orders for the same forbidden graph studied in recent sufficiently-large-n work and supplies complete extremal classifications, giving concrete boundary data for the finite-n transition.
